title: Payload: range rings v1
description: Concentric range rings drawn with a map analysis tool. The envelope geometry is the centre Point; the rings are not stored, they are computed from ring_count and ring_spacing_m (ring k has radius k * ring_spacing_m, measured geodesically). Edits are new records with revision_of.

ring_spacing_m.description: Distance between rings; also the radius of the first ring
